title: Parameter Writer
text: Write to block parameter or variable, 1 input, no direct feedthrough, {Destination} sets Option to write to variables and; {Validate parameter} sets the option to validate parameter during normal mode, {Workspace variable name} sets the name of the workspace variable and {Parameter owner block} sets the block path of parameter owner block and name of block parameter no. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Validate parameter
params.values: Option to validate parameter during normal mode simulation on (default) | off

params.name: Destination
params.values: Option to write to variables and parameters Block parameter (default) | Model workspace variable | Base workspace variable

params.name: Workspace variable name
params.values: Name of the workspace variable no default

params.name: Parameter owner block
params.values: Block path of parameter owner block and name of block parameter no default
